1.title: Police Make Surprise Discovery of Stolen Statue of Olympic Gymnast Sunisa Lee
1.summary: The St. Paul, Minn., police were investigating a report of gunfire when they found a bronze bust of Sunisa Lee, the gold medal Olympian, that was stolen last year.

2.title: Trump Administration Looks to Give a Swath of Yosemite Park to Developer
2.summary: The proposed land swap would allow easy access to the crown jewel of the national park system. Democrats and former Park Service officials are incensed.

3.title: Right-wing commentator Milo Yiannopoulos detained by ICE
3.summary: The British citizen, who lives and works in the US, has supported Trump and ICE agents in the past.

4.title: Live Updates: Scale of Flood Disaster Grows as Nepal Doubles Estimate of Missing
4.summary: A spokeswoman for the Nepali disaster relief agency said the tally grew to 1,900 after some 900 people were reported missing from hydropower projects. Rescue efforts were complicated by fears of new flooding.

5.title: Close race as Iceland votes on whether to restart talks on joining EU
5.summary: Turbulent international affairs have brought the vote forward, but the campaign has focused more on Iceland's vital fishing industry.
